title: Glassdeck package source (deck.json)
description: The hand-written part of a package's manifest; glassdeck pack fills in the rest

id.description: {tld}.{entity}.{name} in lowercase, like local.user.clock. Unique within its type; Glassdeck keys packages by {type}.{id}

details.description: A widget's sizes; a canvas has none, packing works them out

preview_at.description: Seconds into a canvas at which its still is drawn; 0 when left out

network.description: Hosts host.luau may reach with net: a host name, or *.domain for its subdomains

min.description: Smallest size; give min and max together, or neither for a fixed size

max.description: Largest size; give min and max together, or neither for a fixed size
